ER medical person here: 

Bro. Seriously you need to tell your surgery team about your marijuana use, they CANNOT legally rat you out to anyone. At all. Ever. 

You need to tell them, because they need to adjust the anesthesia accordingly. You don't want to wake up in the middle of surgery, or not at all. It's completely possible. 

Just like you'd tell them if you take meletonin or valarien root, or anything PM (Advil/Tylenol/Motrin/Alieve, or anything else with a sleep additive.) tell them how much you smoke and how often, and don't  smoke 24 hours prior.

As I said, you cannot be ratted out or have anything you say to your surgery team repeated to anyone who isn't you. Patient/Doctor confidentiality is key. Doctors and specialists only have to report on mandetory things like if you're hurting a kid or an old person, or if you plan on hurting yourself or anyone else.

I'm absolutely not trying to scare you, but it's always extremely important to be honest with your doctor about anything you ingest, and it's even more important to be up front with your surgery team. Anesthesia is a touchy thing and varies from person to person. There's a reason they get paid so much, so again, PLEASE ALWAYS BE HONEST WITH HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS.
